work.abstract_text: We refute the mixed-state conjecture of Spriet, Langrenez, Brummelhuis and De Bièvre in arXiv:2511.01996v2, Section 6.3 immediately after (6.23), p. 43: a KD-real state and generator can have a KD-real symmetric logarithmic derivative with nonzero quantum Fisher information. Two rank-three projections in dimension nine give a faithful KD-positive state with quantum Fisher information 1/6. The construction gives a one-parameter family, two singular mixed endpoints, and counterexamples in every square dimension n^2 with n>=3. Exclusion holds for states in the real span of the two basis-diagonal spaces, for cyclic-prime Fourier bases, and for all KD-real states when the transition matrix is real up to basis phases. Exclusion also holds for Haar-almost every pair of bases in each finite dimension.

work.title: A KD-positive counterexample to the SLD conjecture in arXiv:2511.01996v2, Section 6.3 after (6.23), p. 43
